reviewers: OpenCodeReview Inkling (zero inline findings; final verdict pending at repair time)

repairs.finding: The Coder four-request cold aggregate reversed the direction of the measured generated-tokens-per-second comparison.
repairs.change: Corrected docs and the Coder receipt to state that Coder was about 5.4% faster on that cold aggregate.

repairs.finding: Architecture still described all routing-trace capture as unbuilt after the decode/verify-window trace was recorded.
repairs.change: Narrowed the unbuilt boundary to batched prompt-prefill routing capture.

repairs.finding: The current Coder artifact date and installer-family boundary were not fully represented in the measured section.
repairs.change: Removed the unsupported calendar date and stated that the run used a separately hashed scratch artifact with a remapped current profile, not the older installer revision.

repairs.finding: A routing file could contain a trailing partial pass and overrepresent early layers while still containing every layer.
repairs.change: The parser now requires equal per-record counts across all 48 layers within each input trace; multiple complete traces may have different equal counts.

repairs.finding: Profile-only manifests labeled null coverage as router-weight coverage.
repairs.change: Profile-only coverage_measure is now null and the CLI prints generic null coverage.

repairs.finding: Removing the version-1 coverage field changed the manifest contract without changing the schema version.
repairs.change: Promoted new plans to strata-prefiller-plan-v2 and documented the v1 field difference.

repairs.finding: CodeRabbit: a high aggregate cache-hit rate alone does not prove decode is expert-miss unbound because miss latency was not attributed.
repairs.change: Replaced the bottleneck conclusion with the 402-miss count and an explicit statement that miss-stall time was not measured.

repairs.finding: CodeRabbit: full-model-versus-Coder speed percentages were ambiguous about their denominator.
repairs.change: The comparison table now states Coder-relative deltas against the full-model baseline for each row.

repairs.finding: CodeRabbit: the Coder engine SHA-256 value had only 63 hexadecimal characters.
repairs.change: Restored the shared engine binary digest to the 64-character value and validated every SHA-256 field in both runtime receipts.

tests_added: partial second-pass trace rejection and multi-file equal per-layer accounting
exact activation coverage numerator and denominator accounting

validation.result: all host-safe checks passed after code and documentation repairs

validation.command: python3 hash-shape validation over both runtime-statistics receipts
validation.result: every declared SHA-256 string matches 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters

non_claims: These are review repairs to documentation, planning metadata validation, and evidence interpretation; no engine runtime behavior changed.
The corrected cold-aggregate direction does not add a new model run or quality claim.
No backend build or model rerun followed these final metadata and documentation edits; the existing B550 measurements remain the runtime evidence.
